title: console first load: plugin-grid, plugin-form and RecordDetailView are still in the eager closure (split from #33293)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oF8GgTHN2jBZoDwz8

Filing gate: split card of #33293 (p3), per its order's split clause; the edges were measured by PR #33580 (os-dev-report 6887255208, PR body "Acceptance notes" → "Why this PR stops here"). Reader: `domain:ui`. Grade p3, the parent's grade, self-graded by the lane seat under the maintainer's 「定级你可以自己决定」.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open eager closure plugin-grid` finds only the parent #33293.

## What the user sees

Every Console route, a dashboard included, still downloads `plugin-grid` (with most of `plugin-detail`), `plugin-form` and `RecordDetailView` before it asks for data: about 287 KB gzipped (upper bound, the five chunks' sum) on the first load, after #33580 took out 130 KB.

## Where (edges read from the module graph of the #33580 build `30cbab20`)

- `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts` bare-imports `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-form` and the core-view plugins.
- `ObjectView` sits in `AppContent`'s always-eager block; `views/objectViewRecordOverlay.tsx` imports `RecordDetailView` statically (`ui/scripts/vite-declared-lazy-views.ts` pins it in `DECLARED_LAZY_VIEWS_STILL_EAGER`).
- app-shell imports named helpers from `@object-ui/plugin-form` (`filterSystemFields`, `isAutoGeneratedFieldType`, `useInitialFieldFocus`, `resolveInlineMode`, `ModalForm`) and `@object-ui/plugin-view` (`deriveRecordSurface`, `deriveRecordFlowSurface`); each package declares only its entry side-effectful, so a helper import keeps the whole registering entry.
- Eleven eager app-shell modules reach `plugin-detail` (`sharedUserFeeds`, `deriveRelatedLists`, `workspacePreference`, `recordPagePayload`, `recordDetailSections`, `RecordPreviewCard`, …).

## Acceptance

- A lazy boundary on `ObjectView` in `AppContent`. It is `EAGER_WALK_CONTROL`, the positive control of `vite-declared-lazy-views`, so that plugin's counter-probe needs a new control.
- `register-plugins.ts`'s eager plugins become `registerLazy` per tag.
- Side-effect-free subpaths (new `exports` entries) for the helpers app-shell imports from `plugin-form` and `plugin-view`: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, contract record owed.
- Measured from `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json` on two builds: the grid, form and `RecordDetailView` chunks leave the closure; what each route draws is unchanged (a built console in a real browser, as #33580's probe in `pm-orders/ui/33293-probe/`).
- Likely more than one PR; split by package if past ~600 lines.

Refs #33293
